map.FLACC量表用于无法自述疼痛的患者（婴幼儿、认知障碍、意识障碍），5个项目各0: The FLACC scale is used for patients who cannot report pain themselves (infants, cognitive impairment, impaired consciousness), 5 items at 0-2 points each, 0-10 total
map.请选择各项目表现后查看评分: Select the performance of each item to see the score
map.非药物干预为主，必要时口服镇痛: Non-pharmacologic measures first, oral analgesia if needed
map.口服镇痛药+非药物干预，评估效果: Oral analgesics plus non-pharmacologic measures, assess the effect
map.强效镇痛，必要时静脉给药，密切监测: Potent analgesia, intravenous dosing if necessary, close monitoring
map.FLACC适用于2个月-7岁儿童、认知障碍成人、谵妄患者、ICU镇静患者等无法自: FLACC applies to children aged 2 months to 7 years, adults with cognitive impairment, delirious patients, sedated ICU patients and others who cannot self-report pain. For adult ICU patients the revised FLACC (r-FLACC) can be used.
map.📚 深度解析：疼痛行为观察（FLACC）评分: 📝A In-depth analysis: pain behavior observation (FLACC) scoring
map.面/腿/活动/哭闹/安抚各 0-2 合计 4/10，中度疼痛，需给予镇痛并复评；: Face/legs/activity/cry/consolability each 0-2 gives 4/10, moderate pain, analgesia should be given and reassessed; 0 means no pain.
map.合计 8（≤6 橙区、≤10 红区），重度疼痛，立即干预并排查病因，30 分钟后: Total 8 (<=6 orange zone, <=10 red zone), severe pain, intervene immediately and look for the cause, then retest after 30 minutes.
map.无法自述疼痛者（婴儿、痴呆、插管）；5 维各 0-2，总分 0-10，≥4 需处: People who cannot self-report pain (infants, dementia, intubated patients); five dimensions at 0-2 each, 0-10 total, >=4 needs action.
map.要算，且很有价值：睡眠 / 安静状态下的 FLACC 基线分反映持续疼痛，活动时: It counts and is highly valuable: a FLACC baseline during sleep or quiet reflects persistent pain, while a score during activity reflects movement-provoked pain. Score at three fixed time points (rest, activity or post-care, and 30 minutes after medication) and read the trend rather than a single value. Note that irritability may also come from hypoxia, urinary retention or fear, so before giving analgesia at a score of 4 or above, rule out these non-pain causes.
